## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 395 captures during February 2023. The activity provides the basis for the month’s image-quality review and grading workload. Records should continue to be maintained in accordance with local operating arrangements so that activity, image quality and grading performance can be monitored consistently.

The clinic should also continue to report operational issues through the established service desk process. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk, supporting follow-up and review of any repeated equipment concerns.

## Image quality

There were 24 ungradable image sets during February 2023. This represented an ungradable rate of 6.1 per cent. The clinic should review these cases through routine quality monitoring and ensure that recurring camera issues are clearly recorded for the service desk.

## Grading

A total of 95 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. These results should continue to be monitored alongside capture volumes and image-quality outcomes to support timely review and identification of any operational issues affecting the service.
